The AI orchestration of your wildest imagination.

Backed by a fiercely inventive community and 500+ builder-approved integrations, we’re changing the way people bring systems together and scale ideas for impact.
Since our founding in 2019, we’ve grown into a diverse team of over 260 - working across Europe and the US, connected by a shared builder spirit and with our centre of gravity in Berlin. Along the way, we’ve:
 - Cultivated a community of more than 650,000 active developers and builders
 - Earned 190K+ GitHub stars, making us one of the world’s Top 40 most popular projects
 - Backed by top investors, from Sequoia’s first German seed to our SAP's recent strategic investment - bringing us to a $5.2bn valuation

We’re in a defining moment of an incredible journey. Come and build with us.
Your main goal will be to make it simple and reliable for customers to buy, pay for, and grow their use of n8n. You'll own the foundations of how n8n's commercial system works: licensing and entitlements, customer accounts, and the metering and billing platform for both Cloud and Enterprise. Today these live across several teams and two billing stacks; you'll bring them into one stable home that the rest of the company builds on.

LICENSING, ENTITLEMENTS & ACCOUNTS

 - Productize the deal-to-entitlement flow so a closed deal in Salesforce creates or updates entitlements without manual steps.
METERING & BILLING PLATFORM
 - Own usage metering and billing for Cloud and Enterprise, including subscription billing: what counts as a billable execution, quota consumption, and overage charging.
 - Lead the migration off Paddle Classic and unify Cloud and Enterprise billing into one platform.
 - Build the mechanics for usage-based enterprise billing and reliable overage charging.
CROSS-ORG ALIGNMENT
 - Make the architecture and mechanism decisions (entitlement model, billing platform, enterprise invoicing path) and align closely with Finance and go-to-market on each of them. Every decision here touches money; you bring people along rather than inform them afterwards.
 - Hold clear boundaries with adjacent teams: the customer console, execution limits, and access control live elsewhere; you own the data and mechanics they rely on.
 - Establish clear success measures and keep the squad accountable for outcomes, not only delivery.

Must-haves
 - Billing or licensing product experience: You have 6+ years in Product, with a substantial part spent owning a billing, licensing, entitlement, or quote-to-cash system at a B2B SaaS company.

title: Senior Product Owner - BKYC
description:
Solaris is Europe’s leading embedded finance platform, pioneering Banking-as-a-Service to bridge the gap between financial technology and licensed banking. Founded in 2016 and headquartered in Berlin, Solaris enables fintechs, digital ecosystems, and multinationals to embed accounts, cards, lending, and payments directly into their own products, creating seamless financial experiences for their users. As a fully licensed German bank, Solaris combines the highest standards of IT security and regulatory resilience with a modular, highly scalable infrastructure.
 Today, Solaris is driving the next evolution of financial services by transitioning into an AI-native banking platform, ensuring European businesses can deploy secure, adaptable financial products at scale.
 Why join Solaris? 
 🚀 We are fundamentally redesigning banking processes around AI orchestration, standardized modular building blocks, and embedded regulatory compliance.
 🎯 We combine tech and banking in dedicated hubs - driving the technology infrastructure out of Berlin and banking operations out of Frankfurt.
 💡 Through our internal mobility, growth opportunities, and the Solaris Academy, we offer continuous learning tracks, AI ambassador mentorship, and upskilling to keep your skills ahead of the curve.
 ⚖️ We foster a workplace rooted in integrity, proactive risk management, and equality actively driving initiatives like DEI initiatives.
 About the role 
 Rapid growth, expanding fintech partnerships, and evolving EU regulatory frameworks (AMLR) make Business KYC one of the bank’s most strategic priorities. As Senior Product Owner for BKYC domain, you will lead the vision, strategy, and execution for our business onboarding and periodic review platforms. You will partner closely with engineering, compliance, and commercial stakeholders to automate manual workflows, reduce processing times, and build scalable systems that unlock business growth while ensuring strict regulatory compliance. You’ll serve as the dedicated leader for our BKYC engineering team, setting clear priorities and driving product excellence from day one.
 While this role focuses on BKYC, strong product owners from adjacent domains - such as retail KYC, CDD, AML, or broader financial crime prevention - are highly encouraged to apply. What matters most is your ability to untangle complex business structures (like corporate hierarchies, cross-border entities, and screening workflows) and translate them into scalable product solutions.
 Your Role
 Take full ownership of a product sub-domain, from conceptualization to delivery, ensuring alignment with overall business goals. Together with the Engineering counterparts form the leadership team for the domain.
 Build and maintain strong relationships with stakeholders across the organization, clearly communicating product visions, strategies, and updates.
 Contribute to the creation and execution of product roadmaps, setting clear priorities and milestones.
 Implement and refine agile methodologies within the development team to enhance productivity and delivery quality.
 Drive the development of solutions that meet market needs and user expectations, staying ahead of industry trends and applying creative thinking to solve problems.
 You participate in the proactive identification, management, and mitigation of risks and findings within your product domain, aligning with Solaris' compliance and policy standards.
 We'd love to see 
 Depending on your level of experience, your responsibilities and scope of role will range. We don’t care much about fancy titles, but rather about real personal and professional development, as laid out in our learning framework. Let’s figure together out how you can contribute to our team.
 A Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in banking, business, engineering or any other related fields. 
 3+ years of experience as a Product Manager/Owner or a similar profession - experience in a banking / fintech environment is a strong advantage.
 Experience in creating new products, dealing with complex code base and maintaining services. 
 Experience in working with engineering teams and understand their mindset and language.
 Exposure to B2B or BaaS environments - where business clients are onboarded through partner channels - is a plus.
 Experience with BKYC processes - such as corporate entity verification, UBO identification, or business customer due diligence - is a strong advantage.
 Awareness of the regulatory landscape affecting BKYC, including evolving EU AML regulations and their impact on business customer onboarding, is highly valued.
 Collaboration with internal stakeholders, such as customer support, marketing and legal to ensure a seamless and compliant integration of customer facing features.
 Exceptional verbal and written communication skills, critical for articulating product visions, strategies, and specific features to diverse stakeholders, including team members, executives, and external partners. For a Senior PO vital for negotiating with stakeholders, managing expectations, and leading strategic discussions.
 Strong leadership skills to inspire, guide, and motivate team members and stakeholders, fostering a collaborative and productive work environment. For
a Senior PO, this involves mentoring junior colleagues and leading by example, demonstrating a high level of professional maturity and the ability to handle complex product initiatives.
 The capacity to quickly adapt to changing market conditions, user feedback, and project constraints. This includes a strong problem-solving orientation that enables the identification and implementation of effective solutions under ambiguity. For a Senior PO, adaptability also encompasses leading teams through high-pressure phases  or changes, maintaining focus on outcomes and quality delivery.
 Comfortable working with AI tools, thinking critically about AI outputs, and contributing to a culture of responsible AI

title: Entrepreneur in Residence (GTM)
description:

title: Product Manager, Financing Products
description:
ABOUT FINMID
finmid is on a mission to build an embedded lending infrastructure that unlocks growth for global platforms and 32 million European businesses. We are the fastest-growing European fintech in 2025 https://sifted.eu/leaderboards/sifted-250-2025 and are trusted by Europe's most ambitious platforms like Wolt, Delivery Hero, Just Eat Takeaway, Guesty and FREENOW.
Join our global team of builders who are nerdy, relentless, and obsessed with solving hard problems that others will not.
ABOUT THE OPPORTUNITY
The team you’ll manage exists for one sentence: every merchant a platform trusts keeps borrowing from us, at a price we set, without anyone touching it.
Our platform customers onboard the merchant and do the KYB. Everything after that is ours: whether a merchant gets an offer, whether they accept it, whether the money reaches them in minutes, and whether they come back for the next one.
You own all of it and every product inside it. Today that is cash advances and loans repaid out of a merchant's sales. In testing, it is vehicle financing for fleet operators and inventory-backed credit lines for e-commerce merchants. What we build after that is your call, along with which markets and verticals we go into next.
You will also own pricing. Risk sets the guardrails, Finance sets the margin bands, and inside them, how we price and what we test is yours.
You will work with the founders, with Risk, with Finance, with the platforms themselves, and with engineers and designers.
IN THIS ROLE, YOU WILL
 - Own the funnel end to end: eligibility, acceptance, payout, renewal, and the numbers behind each.
 - Turn company strategy into product strategy, on a six-month horizon, steered in six-week blocks.
 - Own expansion. New platforms, new countries, and new use cases held together end-to-end.
 - Own pricing. How we structure it, how we test it, and what we do with the result.
 - Be the front door for Commercial, ops and our platform partners, so the team can build.
 - Set the bar for discovery and delivery. The team drives both. You make sure work starts from a real problem and ends with something we can measure.
 - Get the data we need in from the platform, a public register, or the merchant, in that order.
WHAT YOU'LL NEED TO BE SUCCESSFUL
 - 5 to 8 years in product, at least two owning a funnel or conversion metric you were personally judged on.
 - Real evidence of moving a funnel: experiments you ran, what happened, and which ones failed.
 - You know how to test a price. Not credit modelling; we have a Risk team for that. Experiment design: what you change, who you change it for, how long you wait, and how you tell a real result from noise.
 - You have taken a product into new markets or new segments end-to-end, with legal, ops, engineering, and an outside partner all needing to land at once.
 - The nerve to push back on a partner. Platforms are our customer and our supplier at the same time, and not every request is good for the merchant.
 - You still do the work yourself: the spec, the data, and clicking through the merchant flow as a first-time user.
 - You write clearly. Most decisions here are made and defended in writing.
 - Fluency in English.
 - A bias for ownership: you treat the business like it's your own.
Nice to have: hands-on pricing experience, time in a marketplace, platform or embedded finance business, or a stint as the only product person in a company. You do not need a lending background; the credit expertise sits elsewhere in the company.
GROWTH PATH
At finmid, growth follows ownership and impact rather than a fixed path. This role sits at the center of how the company makes money, so the surface area is large from day one. Depending on your strengths, it can grow towards broader product leadership as the team scales or towards deep ownership of pricing and the commercial model.
LOCATION
 - Location: Berlin or Remote (Europe)
 - Start date: as soon as you can
BENEFITS
 - We see ourselves as “distributed first” (i.e. work from anywhere) but also have a beautiful office in Berlin where you can work
 - We are flexible and cover whatever you need to be as productive as possible
 - Home office stipend
 - 30 days time off
 - Meaningful equity
 - Open-minded and transparent culture that includes regular get-together meetings (e.g. All Hands, Brown Bag Lunch, Offsites)
We're looking for people with passion, grit, and integrity. You're encouraged to apply even if your experience doesn't precisely match the job description. We welcome diverse perspectives and people who think out of the box and aren't afraid to challenge assumptions. Join us.

title: Senior Product Manager (Builder) (m/f/d)
description:
JOIN VOYFAI, A FAST-GROWING SERIES A STARTUP SHAPING THE FUTURE OF LOGISTICS AND TECHNOLOGY ACROSS EUROPE.
Headquartered in Berlin, we operate at the centre of a broader group of companies active across several European markets.
This is a unique opportunity to work directly with our Co-Founders from day one, drive meaningful impact and grow within a dynamic, fast-paced environment. Whether you're shaping how we run the company, leading strategic initiatives or building new organisational rhythms from scratch, your contributions will directly influence the success of Voyfai and the companies we support. If you're passionate about building from scratch and excited to be part of a company on the rise, we'd love to hear from you.
YOUR ROLE:
As Senior Product Manager (m/f/d), you own a part of our product from the problem to the release. You spend time with operators in our forwarding companies, decide what is worth building, and design it yourself instead of writing a ticket and waiting. You work with the Head of Product, our engineers and the teams inside our group companies. AI tools are how you work every day, so an idea becomes a clickable prototype in days, not in a sprint.  - Ship the small fixes and improvements yourself instead of adding them to a queue
 - Keep operators, engineers and stakeholders aligned, and say no to the things that do not move the needle in terms of impact.
WHAT YOU BRING:
 - 3 to 5 years in product, ideally in B2B SaaS or operational software, with real ownership and not only delivery
 - Daily practice with AI-native tools, not a few tests on the weekend
 - Design craft you can show, plus enough code to push a small change to production alone
 - Experience running user interviews, and the discipline to cut a messy problem into a small first scope
 - Comfort with ambiguity, and with travel, because many of our users sit in offices in Netherlands, Poland, Germany and beyond
 - Fluent English, and patience with people who use it as a second language
BONUS IF YOU HAVE
 - Exposure to logistics, freight forwarding, customs or another complex operational domain
 - Experience inside acquired companies, where change management weighs as much as the product
WHAT WE OFFER:
 - Competitive salary and equity options
 - A dynamic, fast-paced work environment with a mission-driven team
 - Flexible working arrangements (Hybrid)
 - 30 days of PTO
 - Regular team events and offsites
 - Monthly mobility budget via Navit

What we do
 At getquin, we're on a mission to empower everyone to build wealth.
 Founded in 2020, we started with a simple idea: help people see their entire financial life in one place, so they can make more informed decisions.
 Today, getquin has grown into one of the largest wealth platforms globally, already helping over half a million users manage and grow their wealth. Our platform combines analytics, tools and community to make wealth-building accessible for everyone, not just the experts.
 After launching in Germany, we've started expanding across Europe, with a focus on growing our user base, building valuable new features and helping even more people take control of their financial future.
 If you're excited to help shape the future of personal wealth management, join us. We're just getting started.
What you'll be doing
 You've built products for investors. You know what a TER actually does to a long-run return, why a user with four brokers has no visbility what they really own, and how differently people behave when the number on screen is their pension rather than their pocket money.
 You've probably also hit the ceiling of what a chart can tell someone. Better tables, more filters, another allocation donut. The data was always there; the answer never quite arrived.
 We have something nobody else has: a complete, cross-institution picture of a person's wealth. Investments, cash, liabilities and insurance contracts, in one place, for over half a million users. Your work is turning that into features and insights people understand and act on, and the interesting tools for doing that now include AI.
 We're looking for an experienced Senior Product Manager to own that area. You'll work directly with the founders and the product team, alongside engineering and our financial advisory teams.  Own our efforts to stay on the forefront of digital wealth management services and play your part in disrupting a still very offline industry
 Work the unglamorous, high-leverage problems too: data quality, coverage gaps, missing cost basis, duplicate holdings across connections, ETFs held through more than one broker. A portfolio insight is only as trustworthy as the numbers under it
 Turn the data into something users act on 
 Define the insights we surface about someone's portfolio, cash position and risk, and why each one earns a place on their screen
 Own our conversational AI assistant and our AI-driven insights: what they say, what they refuse to say, and how a user knows which is which
 Set the quality bar for anything we tell a user about their money: accuracy targets, human review, guardrails, rollback. Decide when something is good enough to ship and hold that line when the pressure is to ship anyway
 Own the numbers 
 Define the metrics for your area: activation, engagement, the insight-to-action funnel, and contribution to subscription conversion and retention
 Run the experiments, including proper A/B testing, read them, and report what didn't work alongside what did
 Live in your own product analytics and write your own queries and reporting, rather than wait for someone to give that to you
What we are looking for
 You might be a fit if: 
 You've built wealth management, investing or portfolio products. You know the domain properly: instruments, ETFs, costs, allocation, risk, tax drag, and how retail investors actually behave rather than how they should. This is the requirement we're least flexible on
 You've owned a product area end to end against a number you defined yourself, with real experimentation behind it

 Your own portfolio, and opinions about it

description:
ABOUT US
Zenjob https://www.zenjob.com/en/ is an AI-powered flexible staffing platform that has connected companies and temporary workers since 2015. Companies use our platform to book ready-to-work staff in real time, while students use our app - we call them Zenjobbers - to find part-time jobs that conveniently fit around their studies. Over 40,000 Zenjobbers and 1,000 partner companies from logistics, retail, and hospitality in all major German cities share our belief that good work is not a coincidence. It is the result of innovative technology and genuine commitment. Good work starts here.
THE ROLE
We are seeking a highly skilled Senior Product Manager to join our team. In this role, you will play a key part in defining and executing a product vision that ensures Zenjob’s marketplace dynamics are well balanced, by optimizing our demand forecast, making sure jobs and Zenjobbers are matched optimally, and engaging students in working a high number of shifts.
This is not a role that owns one squad's backlog. You'll work project-based: form a team around a problem, own it end-to-end until it delivers on the expected need. You'll get problem statements, not requirements documents. Recent examples: how shifts get allocated across thousands of Zenjobbers each week, and how we get a new Zenjobber from signup to their first shift without human intervention.
This role suits a Product Manager who is energised by an open-ended problem, and who finds complex workflows genuinely interesting. You'll report to the Director of Product and work across our Supply, Demand and Staffing squads, depending on the problem to solve.
WHAT YOU’LL DO
 - Bring our business goals to reality. Understand our financial goals, our users' problems and transform them into solutions that drive our revenue up.
 - Talk to users directly. Zenjobbers, clients, and our own internal teams. Most of the good opportunities come out of these conversations, not out of a backlog.
 - Do your own data work. You don’t wait until a data analyst gives you the insights, you dive into it and derive them yourself.
 - Turn ambiguity into a defensible plan. Take a problem nobody agrees on yet, and define what we're solving, what we're explicitly not solving, and in what order.
 - Design and run tests. Form a hypothesis, define what would falsify it, ship the smallest thing that gives you a real answer, and be honest about the result.
 - Drive product development from concept to launch. Pull together Engineering, Design, Ops and Commercial around a problem and keep them moving through hypothesis, building, rollout and post-launch decision making
 - Own the outcome, not the output. Each project has a number attached. You define what success looks like up front, and you're the one who says whether it was hit.
 - Communicate clearly. A one-page memo an exec can act on. A spec an engineer doesn't have to interpret. A tradeoff explained to Commercial in terms they care about.
WHAT WE’RE LOOKING FOR
 - 6+ years in product, with meaningful time on products where the software coordinates real-world processes - staffing, logistics, fintech ops, healthcare, or similar, with substantial business impact. You have experience in marketplace dynamics and allocation problems.
 - You've shipped something complex end-to-end and can talk credibly about what broke, not just what launched.
 - You're analytically strong - comfortable getting to an answer yourself rather than commissioning one, and having a fluent conversation with data scientists.
 - You've moved teams you don't manage. Cross-functional influence without formal authority is most of this job.
 - You write and speak clearly. This is the strongest single signal we look for, because in a cross-team role, clear communication is most of how work actually moves.
 - AI is already part of how you work, and you can say specifically where it helps and where it doesn't, and you are already able to ship small features with little to no help from Engineers
 - English fluency. German is a big plus.
WHAT WE OFFER
 - Real ownership of problems that visibly move the business - not a slice of someone else's roadmap.
 - Innovative mission: Together we create something new. Work in a dynamic set-up where you learn a lot and your every idea is heard.
 - Unique team spirit: We can rely on each other blindly and celebrate all successes together as a team.
 - Vacation: Recreation and further education is important, which is why we offer 28 days of paid vacation (increased by 1 day for every 2 calendar years of service with us, up to a maximum of 30 days), 1 day of special leave for community service, 5 days of paid educational leave, and the possibility of unpaid leave
 - Hybrid working model: We love our brand new office in Prenzlauer Berg. But sometimes you need a little more flexibility. Zenjob’s flexible working model combines the best of both worlds, so you can work remotely up to 2 days / week (1 day, during the first 6 months, so we can guarantee you the best onboarding).
 - Dog-lover: If you have a dog, feel free to bring it with you. We don’t bite and always have a bowl of water in our range of drinks
 - Personal growth: Ongoing focus on your personal development (annual training budget of EUR 750, mentoring opportunities, constant career development conversations)
 - Healthy mind in a healthy body: With us you will receive a 30 EUR Urban Sports Club grant to keep you fit. In addition, we have a small sports room in the office ourselves.
 - Always mobile: You will receive EUR 40 credit per month for NAVIT, https://www.navit.com/ a sustainable mobility tool for public transport, bike sharing and much more.
 - Legendary Events: Quarterly team events, winter and summer parties, budget for birthdays and anniversaries of our employees
If this sounds good, then we’d love to find out more about you! Apply and send in your application.

 Cloover is expanding across Europe — and the partnerships that unlock new markets, new installer networks, and new go-to-market channels don't build themselves. We're looking for a Chief of Staff to sit at the centre of that expansion: building strategic partnerships with manufacturers, software companies, and industry players, developing joint go-to-market strategies, and leading the cross-functional projects that make our internal operations scale as fast as our ambitions.
 This is a role for someone who thinks like an entrepreneur, operates like a founder, and wants direct influence on how Cloover grows across Germany and beyond. You'll work across Sales, Tech, and Operations — and you'll lead independently, not as a coordinator.
 You'll report to our  Head of Business Development and work at the centre of the leadership team from day one. 
Your mission
 Build and develop strategic partnerships with manufacturers, software companies, and industry players — with the explicit goal of bringing new installers onto the Cloover platform and unlocking their networks for our financing and software solutions.
 Develop joint go-to-market initiatives with partners that create measurable pipeline — not just relationship management, but commercial outcomes.
 Lead cross-functional projects independently, improving workflows and interfaces across Sales, Tech, Operations, and the trades without needing a brief to get started.
 Analyse existing processes, identify bottlenecks, and develop pragmatic solutions that scale — not just fix the symptom.
 Translate business requirements into practical solutions across teams, bridging the gap between what the business needs and what gets built or deployed.
 Communicate across all levels with clarity and precision — from installers on the ground to senior leadership — and make sure nothing falls through the cracks.
Your profile
 We care more about how you think and what you've built than where you've been. Here's what will set you up for success in this role:
 2+ years of experience in venture development, consulting, or investment banking — ideally in a fast-growing tech or scale-up environment.
 A track record of driving complex, cross-functional projects to measurable business outcomes — not just managing them to completion.
 Moves from a problem to a structured solution without waiting for a full brief — identifies what needs solving and gets started.
 Bridges business and tech teams effectively — can operate in both worlds without losing precision in either.
 Communicates complex topics clearly across audiences: a partner negotiation, an internal process doc, and a leadership update require different registers and delivers all three.
 Fluent in German and English — both required given our markets and internal team.
 Based in Berlin and energised by being in the room. We're intentionally office-first — decisions get made in real time, partnerships get stress-tested over lunch, and the founding team is ten metres away. If that's how you thrive, you'll feel at home here.
 Nice to have — but not required: 
 Experience in energy, climate tech, or proptech.
 Existing network within the installer or renewable energy industry.
 Don't meet every requirement? Apply anyway. We hire for potential and perspective — credentials are a starting point, not a ceiling.

 We keep things transparent and respect your time. Most go from first call to offer in under three weeks.
 Intro call (30 min) — We want to understand what you're looking for, not just screen your CV.
 Hiring manager interview (30 min) — We go deep: your experience, your thinking, how you approach problems.

 Offer & signed contract.

 Performance pay. Strong base, bonus tied to outcomes, and meaningful equity — recognised when it happens, not locked behind annual cycles.
 AI-native & unthrottled. Unlimited enterprise-grade AI — no caps, no approval process. Every role, every team. The grunt work disappears so you can focus on what actually requires human judgement.
 Real ownership on a real mission. From day one you're shaping decisions that impact thousands of installers. We're not just building software — we're powering the energy transition across Europe.
 Grow faster than anywhere else. You'll work directly alongside the founding team and world-class investors. If you're building toward your own venture one day, there's no better room to be in.

title: Product Lead - Growth
description:
HEALTH CAN’T WAIT. 
Not for symptoms to get worse. Not for a six‑month appointment. Not for a system to catch up. But that’s exactly how healthcare works today. You wait, until you can’t.
Alan exists to end the wait.
Health is a universal right, and we believe this right can only become real when it’s coupled with prevention. We need to stop treating health as something we repair and start treating it as something we build, every day. It’s not solely a question of willpower. It’s the healthcare system itself that needs to work for everyone, in a sustainable way.
So we are building the new standard in prevention insurance. Alan is the first company that integrates insurance, prevention, and care into a single, acclaimed user experience.
We are on an incredible journey to build a global leading company, with a unique culture https://alan.com/en/careers. We already partner with 40K+ companies of all sizes, serving more than 1M+ members, and have reached €800M+ in ARR.
Prevention as the new norm. That's what we're building with our team of 1000+ people. If it speaks to you: we're hiring across France, Spain, Belgium, and Canada. And beyond.
⭐️ THE ROLE: PRODUCT LEAD, GROWTH ⭐️
We are looking for a proven product leader to lead the next phase of Alan’s growth.
Our self-serve business now brings in €1M of incremental ARR every week. We got there with a funnel that was ahead of the market for years, built for health insurance, one country and one way of buying. 
That playbook will not get us to the next 10x. Alan is moving to many products, many countries and new segments, and prospects are starting to buy through AI assistants. We need someone who has scaled growth before to write the next playbook and lead the product team that delivers it.
About the Growth area
The Growth area owns Alan’s self-serve business: every member and company that signs up without a sales account executive.
 - It covers individuals (freelancers, retirees, etc) and small companies.
 - It covers everything that happens before someone becomes a member: how prospects find Alan, how they decide we are right for them, and how they start.
 - On the go-to-market side, segment leaders own offer, pricing and channels for their segments, and marketing teams run paid, SEO / GEO, partnerships, brand and more.
 - On the product side, product crews build. Conversion owns the flows and referral surfaces that turn prospects into members. Growth Infrastructure owns the website, marketing measurement and marketing ops.
As Product Lead for Growth, you will lead the product side of the area and partner with our business and marketing leaders to accelerate growth.
A subset of hard questions to answer:
 - One funnel to many: how do we make launching a new funnel for a new product, country or partner as easy as writing a prompt? How do we empower business owners to iterate on the conversion flows?
 - Experience before signing: how does a prospect get to try Mo, the Clinic and the Shop before signing, without slowing down their decision?
 - The comparison moment: how do we become the place people compare insurance on fit and value, when comparison sites rank only on price?
 - Buying through AI: when the journey starts in ChatGPT, how do we become the answer it cites, and the product people can buy right there?
 - Channel leverage: how do we use technology to make each acquisition channel faster, cheaper and smarter, and how do we decide spend on incrementality?
 - Cross-sell at acquisition: how do we sell more than one product from the first signature?
We have strong convictions on some of these and open questions on others. We expect you to bring your own view and to change ours.
What you will do:
 - Set the vision. You will own the multi-year growth product vision, turn it into a small number of big bets, and align the roadmaps behind them. You will also decide what we stop doing, so that we both invest in incremental optimization and big bets.
 - Build an experimentation engine that compounds. We have a baseline of A/B testing and a shared bar for what counts as a win. You will take it to the level covering velocity, rigor, incrementality and learning loops.
 - Make Growth AI-native. You will lead conversational AI in our sales flows, AI-native acquisition surfaces and Alan’s presence in LLM ecosystems. You will also build the AI tooling our marketing teams need to scale their output (content, landing pages, campaigns, lead qualification) without scaling headcount at the same rate.

 Strong practical experience applying AI to real-world problems—not just experimenting with models, but building solutions that people actually use.

Morgan, CapitalG, and Lead Edge Capital. Learn more at grafana.com and follow us on LinkedIn and X . 
 We’re scaling fast and staying true to what makes us different: an open-source legacy, a global collaborative culture, and a passion for meaningful work. Our team thrives in an innovation-driven environment where transparency, autonomy, and trust fuel everything we do.
 You may not meet every requirement, and that’s okay. If this role excites you, we’d love you to raise your hand for what could be a truly career-defining opportunity.
 The Opportunity  
 Grafana's Demand Generation team creates and accelerates pipeline across the full customer journey. We run a modern, AI-forward operation: lifecycle email programs driven by an AI engine, territory-level buying signals surfaced directly to sales leaders, and agentic workflows that handle work that used to take teams of specialists.
 Our webinar program is one of the highest-leverage things we run: technical, practitioner-first sessions on a weekly cadence across AMER, EMEA, APAC and LATAM, putting the product in front of the people who would actually use it. Hands-on sessions, not sales pitches.
 We're hiring a Webinar Program Manager to own it. This is a specialist seat, not a generalist one. You'll inherit an established program with a documented process and a full handover from the person who built it, and you'll own the operating rhythm from there: the calendar, the presenters, the build and promotion of every session, the follow-up, and the reporting.
 This is not a "run the playbook" role. Sessions run in parallel at a pace no one could manage by hand, so the way to raise quality is to keep automating the mechanics. We expect this person to build with AI as a default and treat automation as a first-class deliverable, not a side project.
 You'd be joining a demand gen team that is genuinely rebuilding how the function works, where AI agents run real production programs and the people on the team design the machine rather than turn the crank. The webinar program already produces, and much of the pipeline it touches starts with a session rather than a seller. You're not here to prove webinars matter. You're here to make each one produce more with less manual work behind it.
 What You'll Be Doing 
 Own the webinar calendar end to end. Presenter booking, registration pages, campaign setup, promotion, live delivery, follow-up, and the flip to on-demand, across multiple regions and time zones.
 Keep sessions practitioner-first. Brief technical presenters, shape the outline, and keep a session useful to the audience that registered for it.
 Bring data to topic planning. Use past performance and downstream pipeline quality to recommend what we run and what we retire, and lock the plan with demand gen and product marketing each quarter.
 Automate the production line. Extend the automation behind session setup and promotion, and keep pushing into the parts of the process a person shouldn't be doing by hand, including repurposing recordings into other content.
 Report on what happens after the session. Registrations are the input. Connect sessions to product adoption and pipeline, report it honestly, and flag what isn't producing.
 Grow the program's reach. Expand into additional languages and formats where the numbers justify it.
 What Makes You a Great Fit 
 4+ years in demand generation, event marketing, or lifecycle marketing at a B2B software company (open source or developer-focused a plus).
 Hands-on ownership of a recurring webinar or virtual event calendar across multiple regions. A cadence you were accountable for hitting, not a handful of one-off sessions.
 Hands-on with a webinar platform (ON24, Zoom Webinars, Contrast, Goldcast or similar) and the plumbing behind it: CRM campaigns, registration sync, attendance data, follow-up triggers.
 Comfortable working with technical presenters. You can brief an engineer or solutions architect and hold the line on what the audience came for.
 Hands-on with AI in your actual work: you've built automations or agentic workflows (or are visibly on that path), and you think about AI as leverage, not a threat or a buzzword.
 Comfortable with data: you can pull your own numbers, sanity-check them, and build a program readout a VP would trust.
 Strong program management fundamentals. Twenty-plus moving pieces at once is a logistics job before it's a marketing job, and you ship on time without needing a coordinator.
 Bonus Points For 
 Content repurposing at scale: clips, blog, social, on-demand libraries.
 Localized program experience, and a view on when translation earns its cost.
 Familiarity with the observability, monitoring or open source ecosystem.
 Customer.io, Salesforce and a modern data stack (BigQuery or similar).
 Experience with product-led motions alongside sales-led ones.

 As the Staff Product Manager for Enterprise Deployment Solutions, you'll own the Grafana Labs offerings that run outside our standard multi-tenant SaaS. Grafana Labs is the company behind Grafana Cloud, the fully managed observability platform trusted by more than 10,000 organizations to ensure reliability, resolve incidents faster, and optimize telemetry at scale. Built on open source and open standards and designed for interoperability across any stack, Grafana Cloud brings AI to observability and observability to AI, giving teams (and their agents) unified visibility so they can see, understand, and act on all their disparate data, wherever it lives, and move at the speed of their ambitions. Customers, including Anthropic, Bloomberg, NVIDIA, Microsoft, and Salesforce, rely on Grafana Labs. We are a 100% remote company with team members across 40+ countries, backed by leading investors including Lightspeed Venture Partners, Sequoia Capital, GIC, Coatue, J.P. Morgan, CapitalG, and Lead Edge Capital. Learn more at grafana.com and follow us on LinkedIn and X . 
 We’re scaling fast and staying true to what makes us different: an open-source legacy, a global collaborative culture, and a passion for meaningful work. Our team thrives in an innovation-driven environment where transparency, autonomy, and trust fuel everything we do.
 You may not meet every requirement, and that’s okay. If this role excites you, we’d love you to raise your hand for what could be a truly career-defining opportunity.
 This is a fully remote position and we're considering candidates in the US EST.
 About Product Management
 As a Product Manager at Grafana Labs, you'll develop a vision and strategy for your product domain. You will own the experience for your product as well as its roadmap and competitive positioning, and you will collaborate with company leadership on setting your product's goals. You will be the primary advocate and expert in your area, with a strong ability to communicate needs, functionality, and details effectively both to external customers and internal stakeholders. The teams and people you will be interacting with will be 100% remote and globally distributed, so strong and proactive communication is essential.
 Product Managers are the bridge that connects R&D to GTM. You are a facilitator who ensures the free flow of information across these teams and are expected to be technically proficient when representing our products to our customers.
 The role
 As the Staff Product Manager for Enterprise Deployment Solutions, you'll own the Grafana Labs offerings that run outside our standard multi-tenant SaaS. That includes Grafana Federal Cloud , for organizations that need FedRAMP-authorized observability: US federal agencies; state, local, and education (SLED) customers; and commercial companies that sell FedRAMP offerings of their own. It also includes Grafana Cloud Bring Your Own Cloud (BYOC) , which delivers the full Grafana Cloud experience while the customer pays the infrastructure bill directly to their cloud provider, saving them significantly at scale.
 Your mission is to make Grafana Labs the obvious choice for organizations that can't use standard SaaS because of compliance, data, or cost-at-scale constraints. Deployment choices change the product: features that are simple in standard SaaS can be hard, expensive, or impossible in a regulated or customer-owned environment. You’ll be responsible for adapting existing Grafana Cloud capabilities to these environments, deciding which features come in, which wait, and which stay out, and occasionally building something specific to BYOC or Federal Cloud. You'll also help shape which deployment models we offer next.
 Along the way, you’ll use AI tools daily to speed up research, analyze product signals, and develop positioning, applying strong judgment to the results.
 As the Staff Product Manager for Enterprise Deployment Solutions, you will: 
 Define the vision, strategy, and roadmap for the Grafana Bring Your Own Cloud and Grafana Federal Cloud products, using product data and market research to balance customer value against engineering cost and technical constraints
 Own positioning, messaging, and differentiation for these products, including how they compare to regular Grafana Cloud, and partner with Product Marketing on launches, competitive analysis, enablement, and demand programs
 Partner with Engineering and Technical Program Management on buildouts for these environments, balancing customer timelines with engineering capacity
 Work directly with customers, prospects, and the field on strategic deals and brief partners, resellers, and analysts on our deployment options
 Partner with Security, Compliance, and Legal to work through product changes affecting our authorization or existing customer commitments
 We’re excited about you because you have
 5+ years of product management experience on a technical B2B product, or a technical background (software engineering, solutions architecture, SRE, or technical program management) plus a demonstrated move into product ownership
 Hands-on experience with a non-standard SaaS deployment model, such as self-managed, air-gapped, sovereign, BYOC, single-tenant, or FedRAMP/government cloud, and a firsthand understanding of how it changes the product, its operations, and its economics
 Experience with cloud infrastructure, platform software, or developer tools
 Clear product and go-to-market judgment: you've shaped what a product should be and how it's positioned and sold, not only when it ships
 Interest in working with US public sector customers and learning their needs and buying cycles. Deep compliance expertise isn't required.
 Experience leading across multiple teams without direct authority, with excellent written and verbal communication in a remote, globally distributed organization
 Bonus Points
 Experience selling to or building for US federal, state, or local government customers, or other highly regulated industries
 Familiarity with government or sovereign cloud frameworks, such as FedRAMP, StateRAMP/GovRAMP, BSI C5, or Sec

 The opportunity: 
 As the Staff Product Manager for OpenTelemetry Experience, you’ll own the end-to-end journey for helping people and agents instrument workloads and successfully send useful OpenTelemetry data to Grafana Cloud.
 Your mission is to make Grafana Cloud the easiest and most trusted destination for OpenTelemetry workloads. You’ll reduce the uncertainty, complexity, and failure points users encounter between deciding to adopt OpenTelemetry and receiving healthy, correctly attributed, and actionable telemetry in Grafana Cloud.
 Teams can instrument workloads, directly or with the help of coding agents, through OpenTelemetry SDKs, automatic instrumentation technologies such as Beyla and SDK injection, or client-side OpenTelemetry Collectors. Each path presents different decisions, deployment requirements, configuration steps, and potential failure modes. You’ll define a coherent experience that helps users choose the right approach, complete setup successfully, troubleshoot problems, and understand whether their telemetry is healthy and useful. You’ll design a future in which a growing share of instrumentation work is performed by coding agents acting on behalf of developers. This means treating agents are first-class participants in the experience and ensuring that instrumentation options, configuration requirements, errors, and validation signals are structured, discoverable, and actionable by both humans and machines. 
 Your scope will include:
 OpenTelemetry SDK onboarding and configuration
 Automatic instrumentation experiences, including OBI/Beyla and SDK injection
 Client-side OpenTelemetry Collector deployment and onboarding
 Collector configuration, authentication, and initial connectivity
 Guidance and machine-readable context that help people and agents choose the right instrumentation approach
 Workflows that allow coding-agents to implement, configure and verify instrumentation safely
 Troubleshooting missing, incomplete, malformed, or unhealthy telemetry
 Validation signals that allow both people and agents to confirm that telemetry is healthy, correctly attributed, and usable in Grafana Cloud
 The transition from receiving telemetry to activating the appropriate Grafana Cloud observability solution
 Success does not stop when Grafana Cloud receives the first data point. Telemetry must arrive with the quality, context, and structure required to support meaningful observability outcomes. description:
ABOUT DOCPLANNER AND NOA
Docplanner is a global healthcare platform connecting more than 300,000 doctors with approximately 100 million patients every month across 13 markets.
Within Docplanner, Noa is on a mission to help people live longer, healthier lives. We build AI that works alongside doctors to:
 - Remove their administrative work.
 - Help them make better decisions and handle repeatable cases, so they can spend their time where it matters most.
 - Help patients navigate healthcare using their medical history as personalized context.
We're already in doctors' hands: Noa Notes takes documentation off their plates, while Noa Evidence brings trustworthy medical evidence to the point of care.
The next frontier is the hardest—and the most valuable: helping doctors, and eventually patients, make decisions while our AI safely takes on repeatable clinical work. That's where a doctor's judgment has to live inside the product itself. That's this role.
ABOUT THE ROLE
You'll help take Noa from writing notes and providing evidence to helping doctors decide—and make sure that doctors and users trust it.
This isn't a traditional CMO, advisory or regulatory role. It's a hands-on clinical-product role: the clinician–product–AI. You'll do two things:
 - Help decide what we build for doctors by bringing their real needs, habits and workflows into the product.
 - Define the clinical quality of what we ship: what's correct, useful and safe, and make sure we can prove it.
Because you're a doctor yourself, you can talk to our users peer-to-peer and get the honest answers a survey never will. As our first dedicated clinical hire on the product, you'll set the approach, then help grow clinical expertise across Docplanner's AI product teams.
You'll work day-to-day with Product, AI, Design, Engineering, Regulatory and our doctor network.
WHAT YOU'LL DO
SHAPE WHAT WE BUILD
 - Bring how doctors really work (habits, preferences, workflow, admin) into the product.
 - Talk to doctors, doctor-to-doctor, and turn candid feedback into product decisions.
 - Partner with Product on the roadmap: what to build and what will actually get used.
MAKE SURE IT'S CLINICALLY SOUND
 - Define the clinical quality bar and intended outcomes for our AI products.
 - Review and improve prompts, model outputs, clinical templates, workflows and terminology.
 - Spot clinical failure modes: what good and unacceptable outputs look like.
 - Direct clinical evaluation: decide what to test, in what mix (specialty, population, complexity and edge cases), and set the bar. You'll bootstrap this with a dedicated owner who runs the process, tooling and annotation guidelines for doctors, while our clinical network performs the annotation.
 - Turn model errors and clinician feedback into concrete product and model improvements.
KEEP IT SAFE AND SCALABLE
 - Work with ML/LLM teams, Regulatory experts and the PRRC to keep intent, evidence, risks and controls aligned, including EU MDR-related and similar requirements.
 - Build feedback loops with practising clinicians and our consultant-doctor network.
 - Define how clinical-product expertise scales across future products, teams and markets.
WHAT WE'RE LOOKING FOR
 - A medical degree and meaningful experience practising medicine, with a strong understanding of clinicians' day-to-day work. Active licensure and current clinical practice are not required, although recent or ongoing practice is valuable.
 - You've helped build and ship a digital health, clinical software or AI product—either within a product team or through meaningful entrepreneurial experience.
 - You've turned clinical problems into product decisions, not just provided advice or review.
 - Strong clinical judgment: you turn quality and safety into standards technical teams can use.
 - You win doctors' trust quickly—you are the peer who gets the honest answer.
 - You communicate clearly and directly across clinical, product, technical, regulatory and leadership teams.
 - You're comfortable working at a senior, hands-on level in a fast-moving, international team.
 - You actively use generative AI and understand its potential and limitations. Hands-on experience with prompting, evaluation, error analysis, human oversight or AI-assisted development tools such as Cursor and Claude Code is a plus.

 - Clinically grounded evaluation sets and thresholds in place.
 - A repeatable way to turn medical expertise into better product and model decisions.
WHY JOIN NOA AT DOCPLANNER

title: Product Manager, Editing Foundations
description:
ABOUT US

We've raised Series B funding and reached 300+ million users worldwide, processing over 5 billion images annually and serving both small businesses and major enterprises like Amazon, DoorDash, and Decathlon through our mobile app, web platform, and API.
We're a team of 100+ passionate builders giving e-commerce businesses superpowers to create visuals that help them grow, making the hardest parts of selling online disappear. We focus on craft, innovation, and collaboration to create exceptional impact for e-commerce businesses worldwide.
ROLE SUMMARY
We're looking for a Product Manager to own the editor: the surface every Photoroom user touches, on iOS, Android and the web. You'll sit in our Product Foundations team, whose mission is to build the core experiences that power Photoroom. You will work on the last-mile editing problem, giving users control with fine-grained edits for photos and videos. Working closely with engineers, designers, and the PMs who depend on you, you'll decide what gets built, why, and how it ships.
Location: Paris, Ile de France (Hybrid)
ABOUT THE ROLE
 - Own the single- and multi-image editing experiences end to end. Build one unified visual editing experience across three platforms, iOS, Android, Web and API.
 - Integrate visual editing experiences within chat editing. Photoroom gives users the ability to start with AI generation and then graduate into fine-grained editing tasks. You’ll work hand-in-hand with our researchers and engineers to make sure our users can traverse the full editing journey in Photoroom.
 - Define the problem before the solution. Sharpen the user problem, then partner with design and engineering to ship work that feels effortless. On a surface this heavily used, the difference between "works" and "feels right" is the whole job.

title: Produktmanager (w/m/d) Marktforschung - 2 Jahre befristet
description:
Über uns
Wir wollen etwas bewegen – bist Du dabei? Wir sorgen dafür, dass über 80 Millionen Menschen in Deutschland von einer digitalen Gesundheitsversorgung profitieren können. Einige Produkte von uns, wie das E-Rezept oder die elektronische Patientenakte (ePA), kennst Du vielleicht schon. Gestalte mit uns das Gesundheitssystem von morgen.
 Dein Arbeitsbereich: Produktmanagement 
 Die Abteilung Produktmanagement verantwortet die fachliche (Weiter-)Entwicklung unserer Anwendungen wie der elektronischen Patientenakte (ePA), dem elektronischen Rezept (E-Rezept) oder digitalen Kommunikationslösungen (KIM/TI-Messenger) sowie unserer technischen Plattformleistungen wie Zugängen und Identitäten im Gesundheitswesen. Wir verstehen die komplexen Anforderungen der Gesundheitsversorgung und bilden die Brücke zur Gestaltung nutzerzentrierter, marktfähiger, digitaler Lösungen für die Menschen im Gesundheitswesen, um die Versorgungsqualität und -effizienz spürbar zu verbessern und die Patientensouveränität zu stärken.
Deine Aufgaben
 Du trägst eigenständige Verantwortung für unsere inhouse Marktforschungsprojekte und betreust unsere E-HealthCommunity. In einem Methodenmix aus qualitativer und quantitativer Markt- und Produktforschung erzeugst du Insights, die in der Produktentwicklung und darüber hinaus von zentraler Bedeutung sind.
 Du erstellst und programmierst Fragebögen und konzipierst Leitfäden, führst Interviews durch und analysierst die Ergebnisse.
 Gemeinsam mit deinen Kolleg:innen aus dem Produktmanagement und anderen Abteilungen der gematik erarbeitest du mögliche Handlungsoptionen für die Verbesserungen unserer Produkte. Dafür stärkst du aktiv das interne Netzwerk der Research-Abteilung. 
 Du entwickelst unsere E-Health-Panel mit deinen Ideen kontinuierlich weiter. Du hast die Bedürfnisse der Nutzer:innen stets im Blick und gestaltest eine Community, die begeistert, wächst und langfristig aktiv bleibt. 
 Du steuerst externe Dienstleister, die das Researchteam bei der Datenerhebung unterstützen. Außerdem koordinierst du Ausschreibungsverfahren und unterstützt bei der Vertragsgestaltung.
 Du führst die Budgetplanung, das Controlling und Reporting für deinen Bereich durch. 
 Dein Profil
 Ausbildung: Du hast ein abgeschlossenes Hochschulstudium und besitzt einschlägige Berufserfahrungen im Bereich Marktforschung sowie Projektmanagement. Idealerweise hast Du Erfahrung im IT-Umfeld, eHealth und/oder Gesundheitswesen. Du hast bereits Erfahrungen in der betrieblichen Marktforschung oder in einem Marktforschungsinstitut gesammelt – idealerweise als DIY-Marktforscher:in. Wenn du dich mit der Steuerung externer Marktforschungsdienstleister auskennst – umso besser. 
 Erfahrung: Du bringst mindestens 3 Jahre Berufserfahrung in einem vergleichbaren Aufgabenfeld mit und bist mit der Erhebung, Analyse und Auswertung von Daten vertraut. Auch bi- und multivariate statistische Verfahren sind kein Fremdwort für Dich. Deine Ergebnisse kannst du adressatengerecht präsentieren.
 Tool- und Methodenkenntnisse: Du beherrschst SPSS, R oder ein vergleichbares Tool souverän. Idealerweise hast Du bereits ein eigenes Onlinepanel in Zusammenhang mit Marktforschung betreut und verfügst über Erfahrungen mit Mailing- (bspw. Mailchimp) sowie Umfragetools (bspw. Limesurvey). Außerdem integrierst du KI verantwortungsbewusst in deine täglichen Arbeitsprozesse. 
 Arbeitsweise: Du arbeitest strukturiert, eigenverantwortlich und organisiert. Dein ausgeprägtes analytisches Denkvermögen und deine Konzeptionsstärke helfen dir dabei, Projekte in die Tat umzusetzen. Komplexe Projekte koordinierst du vorausschauend. Dabei gehst du lösungs- und zielorientiert vor und bringst Flexibilität mit, falls die Dinge doch mal anders kommen. 
 Persönlichkeit: Du bist eine kommunikationsstarke Persönlichkeit, die die Digitalisierung des Gesundheitsweisen mit Leidenschaft und Engagement vorantreiben möchte. Du agierst souverän und mit Teamgeist und hast Freude daran, neue Dinge zu entdecken. Deine Aufgaben löst du hands-on und behältst auch bei komplexen Themen den Überblick. 
 Du erfüllst nicht alle Anforderungen? Kein Problem, bewirb Dich trotzdem! Wir prüfen jede Bewerbung individuell und freuen uns darauf, Deine einzigartigen Fähigkeiten und Erfahrungen kennenzulernen.
Das bieten wir Dir
 Job mit Sinn: Wir verpassen dem Gesundheitssystem ein Update – Denk mit uns Gesundheit digital.  
 Perspektive & Entwicklung: Bei uns erhältst Du eine auf zwei Jahre befristete Anstellung mit der Option auf Verlängerung. Wir bieten Dir nicht nur einen sicheren Arbeitsplatz, sondern auch vielfältige Chancen zur persönlichen und beruflichen Weiterentwicklung – durch individuelle Weiterbildungen, unseren gematik CAMPUS, Workshops, Messen und Konferenzen.  
 Agiles Arbeitsumfeld: Bei uns liegt der Fokus auf abteilungsübergreifendem Austausch und der Zusammenarbeit in crossfunktionalen Teams. Dabei stehen gemeinsames Lernen und die Freude an der Arbeit im Vordergrund.   
 Benefits: Neben einem attraktiven Gehalt bieten wir Dir 30 Tage Urlaub sowie zusätzlich freie Tage am 24.12. und 31.12., Gesundheits- und Sportangebote, Zuschuss zum Deutschlandticket, Mitarbeitendenevents, Corporate Benefits und vieles mehr.  
 Mobiles Arbeiten:  Innerhalb Deutschlands ist mobiles Arbeiten nach Absprache möglich. Gleichzeitig freuen wir uns über eine persönliche Zusammenarbeit vor Ort und wünschen uns daher für diese Position eine Büropräsenz von zwei bis drei Tagen pro Woche. Zusätzlich kannst du bis zu 30 Tage im Jahr im europäischen Ausland (EU, EWR oder Schweiz) arbeiten.
 Work-Life-Balance: Vereinbarkeit von Privatleben und Beruf ist uns wichtig, daher gestaltest Du Deine Arbeitszeit flexibel. Wir sind flexibel und gehen auf Deine individuellen Bedürfnisse ein, einschließlich des Wiedereinstiegs nach der Elternzeit – gerne auch in Teilzeit, wenn es für Dich passt.
